name: Integra Capital Limited
about: Integra Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financial services to individuals and businesses in India. The company invests in capital market operations, and mutual funds and other investments; brokerage activities; and provides consultancy and advisory services, as well as offers one-stop investment solutions. It also provides international and domestic financial services in the areas of direct equity, mutual funds, insurance, and real estate, as well as in the disciplines of accounting, tax, and law. The company was formerly known as Integra Capital Management Limited and changed its name to Integra Capital Limited in October 2023. Integra Capital Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in New Delhi, India.
